about_the_game: Current demo includes Episode 1 (15% of the future final story). Our heroes arrive on a private artificial island in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. Who is this mysterious Daniel Heartman? And what is he hiding from view here?

name: Heart of Pacific Demo

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and later
  • Processor: 2,0 GHz Core 2 Duo
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 or DirectX 9.0c
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
